correctness.rationale: The standalone standard-library verifier reconstructs each of the 18,494 simplices directly from the 21 open neighborhoods, exhaustively checks all 9,120 facet/cofacet matching pairs, and topologically sorts the full 18,494-vertex reversed-matching Hasse diagram. Critical vector is (1,0,0,246,7); exact signed integral gradient recursion produces zero for every one of the 7-by-246 4-to-3 Morse coefficients. By Forman the finite complex has a CW Morse model with one 0-cell, 246 3-cells, seven 4-cells; by Hurewicz on its 2-connected 3-skeleton, vanishing signed boundaries make all four-cell attaching maps null. Complete certificate, source code, exact execution output and limits are included; no finite extrapolation is involved.

value.rationale: The canonical 21-vertex triangular/Johnson graph is the first member of the triangular-graph family known to have mixed-degree mod-two neighborhood homology. Exact integral homotopy is a natural stronger invariant and the previously published calculation explicitly leaves integral torsion and attaching maps unresolved. The new complete homotopy classification resolves both with a 246/7 sphere decomposition, giving a reproducible nontrivial benchmark rather than a routine Betti-number recomputation. No conjectural downstream theorem or general n-dependence is claimed.
